layers.authority: SERNANP (Servicio Nacional de Areas Naturales Protegidas por el Estado)
layers.process: Manu National Park: the single tariff (tarifa unica) that applies to visitors who are not Peruvian residents is S/ 60 for 1 day (about A$24.58), S/ 90 for 2 to 3 days (A$36.87) and S/ 180 for 4 to 30 days (A$73.75), in tariff group I. Under-5s, people with disability and tourist guides enter free. The lower special tariff is for nationals and resident foreigners only. The head of each area can set promotional rates. A$ about: S/ 1 = A$0.41 (PEN 3.467 per USD, central-bank-rates.json 30 Oct 2026, with RBA A$1 = USD 0.7040).

Under-5s, people with disability and tourist guides enter free. The lower special tariff is for nationals and resident foreigners only. The head of each area can set promotional rates. A$ about: S/ 1 = A$0.41 (PEN 3.467 per USD, central-bank-rates.json 30 Oct 2026, with RBA A$1 = USD 0.7040).
